title: GroundedAnswer
description: Output contract for the chat-answer prompt module: an answer drawn only from the retrieved fragments, with every claim naming its source. The citations envelope is REQUIRED and must hold at least one entry - an answer that does not name its sources does not validate (ADR-0023).

answer.description: The grounded answer, drawn from the supplied fragments.

citations.description: The citations envelope: one entry per grounded claim, naming the fragment it came from and that fragment's source_id.

fragment_id.description: The retrieved fragment this claim came from.

source_id.description: The fragment's source identifier: a bridge family plus revision, a tool call id, or a ticket id.

revision.description: The source revision the fragment was read at, when the source is versioned.

claim.description: The span of the answer this citation grounds.
